description: 6,000 append-only additions: 500 per theme. Reviewed structural filters, French common animal names, unique article/answer keys, answer-safe clues; short descriptions from Wikidata and adapted Wikipedia/Wiktionary introductions. Editorial checks are not an independent fact audit of all entries.
